The '''Yutuski rakehell''' was a model of large [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] during the later stages of its [[Xim's Expansionist Period|expansionist period]]. Named for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yutusk]], the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were believed to be [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]-class by [[Ximology|Ximologist]] [[Historian/Legends|historians]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the reign of Xim.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yutuski rakehell were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book released in [[2012]] and written by [[Jason Fry]].
